intents.title: understand or answer
steps: Read the orientation, then the authoritative sections with their preambles and scope corrections.
Separate what is specified, what the code does, what current scope defers and what was verified, with the evidence date.
Check the code under 'Where the code lives' before describing current behavior.
Cite `path › section` and `file:line`, and say what you did not check.
intents.finish: A cited answer separating specified, implemented, deferred and verified behavior; no edits.

intents.title: add or modify
steps: Read the authoritative sections, then evaluate each 'read more when' condition and add the topics that apply.
Inspect callers, consumers, local changes and each affected repository's AGENTS.md.
Size the process to risk: a focused fix goes straight to implementation; consequential work gets a plan first.
Complete producer and consumer work together and update guidance the change makes inaccurate.
Run the repeatable verification workflow: smoke baseline plus impact-based checks, and browser journeys when UI is affected.
intents.finish: Checks ran on the final code, results and skipped checks are recorded, and affected documentation is current.

intents.title: check a diff
steps: Read the authoritative sections and acceptance scenarios for the areas the diff touches.
Trace callers and consumers outside the diff, including other repositories.
Report only reachable failures, each with file, line, scenario and evidence.
intents.finish: Findings ranked by severity with failure scenarios, or a clear statement that none survived verification.

intents.title: unexpected behavior
steps: Check current worker scope and Current scope notes first: the behavior may be deferred, not broken.
Compare the authoritative sections with the code and recent evidence; `context.py find` returns dated status sections.
Reproduce with isolated fixtures before changing anything; inspect processes, ports and data first.
Classify the cause as defect, deferred behavior, environment or misuse, with evidence.
Continue a fix with the change intent.
intents.finish: A diagnosis backed by reproduction or evidence; any fix follows the change intent.

intents.title: run, release, recover
steps: Follow the runbook for the operation; inspect processes, ports and data before starting or stopping anything.
Confirm authorization: publishing, merging, production deployment and shared-service changes need it, and operating teams own infrastructure.
Use the dedicated migration job; no service migrates on startup.
Record commands, revisions, environment and results as delivery evidence.
intents.finish: The operation is done, or stopped at an authorization boundary, with revisions and results recorded.
